categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches p2p connection management and private transaction relay in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp, under the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents adversaries from correlating private broadcasts via a timing side channel where returning a transaction early suppressed remaining outbound connections. The PR directly targets transaction origin privacy, resolving the theoretical timing leak highlighted in issue comments on PR #34707 and PR #29415.
